title: Secrets & Zero Trust
prereqs: Optional: Vault / External Secrets Operator / sealed-secrets
description: Stop shipping secrets in plaintext and trust nothing by default: secret managers (HashiCorp Vault — static & dynamic secrets, leases, rotation), External Secrets Operator & sealed-secrets on Kubernetes, encryption at rest & envelope encryption (DEK/KEK/KMS), workload identity & mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE), and zero-trust network posture — each a runnable exercise against a local Vault / kind, or pure-Python crypto.
